original:
रामो रामो राम इति प्रजानामभवन् कथाः ।
रामभूतं जगदभूद् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति ॥
sanskrit:
रामो रामो राम इति प्रजानामभवन् कथाः ।
रामभूतं जगदभूद् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति ॥
transliteration:
rāmo rāmo rāma iti prajānām abhavan kathāḥ |
rāmabhūtaṃ jagad abhūd rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati ||
translation: While Sri Rama ruled the kingdom, the people spoke only of Rama, Rama, Rama! The entire world became transformed into the righteous spirit of Rama.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: जब श्रीराम राज्य का शासन कर रहे थे, तब प्रजा के मुख पर केवल 'राम, राम, राम' की ही चर्चा थी; सम्पूर्ण जगत राममय हो गया था।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: जेव्हा श्रीराम राज्याचे पालन करत होते, तेव्हा प्रजेच्या मुखात केवळ 'राम, राम, राम' हीच नामचर्चा होती; संपूर्ण जग राममय झाले होते.

layers.author: govindaraja
layers.content: The immortal depiction of Rama Rajya—an epoch free from disease, untimely death, poverty, and sorrow.

layers.author: ralph_griffith
layers.content: The golden age of universal righteousness where all citizens delighted in truth and dharma.

original:
न पर्यदेवन् विधवा न च व्यालकृतं भयम् ।
न व्याधिजं भयं चापि रामे राज्यं प्रशासति ॥
sanskrit:
न पर्यदेवन् विधवा न च व्यालकृतं भयम् ।
न व्याधिजं भयं चापि रामे राज्यं प्रशासति ॥
transliteration:
na paryadevan vidhavā na ca vyālakṛtaṃ bhayam |
na vyādhijaṃ bhayaṃ cāpi rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati ||
translation: Under the reign of Sri Rama, no widow lamented, there was no fear of wild beasts, and no terror of sickness tormented the people.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: श्रीराम के शासन में कोई विधवा विलाप नहीं करती थी, न जंगली पशुओं का भय था और न ही कोई व्याधि-जनित कष्ट था।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: श्रीरामांच्या राज्यात कोणतीही विधवा शोक करत नव्हती, श्वापदांचे भय नव्हते आणि कोणत्याही रोगाचे भय नव्हते.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: दैहिक, दैविक और भौतिक—तीनों तापों से मुक्त रामराज्य का पावन वर्णन।

layers.author: rama_tilaka
layers.content: Demonstrates the reciprocal blessing of a sovereign who lives entirely for the spiritual upliftment of his subjects.

original:
इदं पवित्रं पापघ्नं पुण्यं वेदैश्च सम्मितम् ।
यः पठेद् रामचरितं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
sanskrit:
इदं पवित्रं पापघ्नं पुण्यं वेदैश्च सम्मितम् ।
यः पठेद् रामचरितं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
transliteration:
idaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyaṃ vedaiś ca sammitam |
yaḥ paṭhed rāmacaritaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
translation: This sacred Ramayana, destroyer of sins, auspicious, equal in sanctity to the Vedas—whoever reads this life of Rama is liberated from all transgressions and attains supreme peace.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: यह वेदों के समान पवित्र, पापनाशक और पुण्यमयी रामकथा जो भी पढ़ता या सुनता है, वह समस्त पापों से मुक्त होकर परम पद को प्राप्त करता है।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: हे वेदांसमान पवित्र, पापनाशक आणि पुण्यमय रामचरित्र जो कोणी वाचतो, तो सर्व पापांतून मुक्त होऊन परम शांती प्राप्त करतो.

layers.author: govindaraja
layers.content: The concluding Phalasruti of the Valmiki Ramayana, sealing the immortal blessing upon every listener and reader through the ages.

layers.author: ralph_griffith
layers.content: Griffith closes his monumental translation noting that the Ramayana remains the soul and guiding light of Indian civilization.
